name: measured_fsr
source: measured.json + the printed FSR foot: L3 knee-axis -> toe tip 87 mm, operator, 2026-10-01
notes: The measured body WITH the FSR toe modules fitted. Everything except the three
values below is measured.json unchanged, so an A/B against it isolates the leg.
links.l3 0.0765 -> 0.087: knee axis to the toe tip, measured by the operator on the
assembled foot (2026-10-01). One value for all four feet. The toe is a R7 ball,
but the sim keeps its point toe at the end of L3 (foot_fsr_mod.md 5.2: the
error is +0.10 mm at 10 deg of sweep and +0.94 mm at 30 deg).
chassis.standing_y 0.0823 -> 0.0927: the same construction measured.json uses,
coxa_z_drop + L3*sin(80 deg) = 7.0 + 85.7 mm, so the toes touch the floor at spawn.
masses.lower +0.002: the printed foot, ~2 g each (foot_fsr_mod.md 5.5).
NOT changed, deliberately: ground_clearance stand_m stays 0.06 in both the sim
(GROUND_CLEARANCE_STAND) and the robot (pi_host/calib/sensors.json), because it must
match across the two. The taller stance spends more of its range near the clamp at 1.0;
making it adaptive is its own lever (foot_fsr_mod.md 5.3).
